messages:
sasha: Quick heads-up — soft freeze window starts in ~30m (20:00 UTC). There's a late change that needs a late-merge exception: PR #5478 (version bump + changelog).

miguel: which changelog file? happy to review if it's small.

sasha: docs/changelog/2.18.md — tiny entry, bump from 2.17.9 -> 2.18.0, and a fix in versioning code that unblocks a customer. CI green locally but org CI flaky on linux-x86 tests.

emily: @sasha can you paste the exact commit and the cherry-pick commands so SRE can sign off? we need a rollback plan. :eyes:

sasha: commit 7a9f3b2. Cherry-pick I used: 
```
git fetch origin main
git checkout -b hotpatch/v2.18-bump main
git cherry-pick 7a9f3b2
git push origin hotpatch/v2.18-bump
```

priyanka: CI is showing intermittent timeout in e2e on main; devops-oncall, are we comfortable with a manual smoke on staging and then a merge?

devops-oncall: quick status: staging infra has room; can run smoke tests. We're still investigating flaky e2e timeouts (related to test infra quota). If you can provide a manual smoke checklist we'll run it.

miguel: i'm fine to +1 the PR after a manual staging smoke (basic auth flows, inference runtime start, health checks). Who owns the changelog commit?

sasha: changelog entry is already in PR #5478, but release notes owner is @priyanka — tagging for confirmation.

priyanka: got it. I'll own the release note. If devops runs smoke and confirms no regression, I can approve changelog and we can request late-merge exception.

release-coordinator-bot: Reminder — code freeze policy: late merges require: 1) change <200 LOC or scoped hotfix, 2) SRE signoff, 3) release owner approval, 4) short rollback plan. Use /request-late-merge in #eng-releases.

sasha: matches our case. change is ~12 LOC in version bump + one-line changelog. rollback plan: revert cherry-pick branch and redeploy previous canary. I'll include exact rollback steps in the request.

emily: +1 from me for running the manual smoke. devops-oncall, can you run the smoke in the next 20 minutes?

devops-oncall: will run smoke now, ETA 12m. I'll post results here.

(devops-oncall posts): smoke check started on staging: health endpoints, startup, auth login, basic inference run.

(devops-oncall posts): smoke PASS — health ok, simple gen request returned within latency SLO, no errors in logs. e2e flaky test unrelated.

miguel: thanks. emily, priyanka — any objections?

emily: no objections, approve.

priyanka: approve for release notes and merge exception.

sasha: filing exception request now. /request-late-merge PR-5478 reason: customer-blocking version bump, small diff, staging smoke passed, rollback plan included.

release-coordinator-bot: Late-merge request received: PR-5478. Notifying on-call and release leads. Please allow up to 15 minutes for manual approval.

(devops-oncall): leaving a note — watch for CI flakes post-merge; will monitor first 30m after rollout.

miguel: once approved, I'll merge and monitor. Tagging follow-up: add a short note in the release checklist about flaky e2e so we don't block next time.

sasha: thanks everyone. If anything pops, ping here. :thumbsup:

(15m later) release-coordinator-bot: Late-merge approved by release-lead and SRE. You may merge.

miguel: merging now.

miguel: merge complete, bump tag created v2.18.0-rc1, deploying canary.

devops-oncall: canary deployed, initial metrics look clean. continuing 30m watch.

sasha: adding note to release board about root cause of e2e flakes and follow-up ticket. Thanks all. :tada:
